practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (78%)
practiceReport.beatComment: The Saints expect to have a better feel for Johnson's status Wednesday, when the team holds its first practice of Week 12. Before exiting Sunday in the third quarter, Johnson was targeted just once and failed to record a reception for the second time in 10 appearances on the season. If the hamstring injury prevents Johnson from playing next weekend in Cincinnati, Noah Fant and Oscar Delp would be in line for added snaps at tight end.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Christen Miller
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Miller is dealing with a knee injury and is now required to miss at least four games. The rookie nose tackle has played in four games this season, logging five tackles (two solo) over 93 snaps on defense and four snaps on special teams. Nathan Shepherd and Khristian Boyd could both get more defensive snaps during Miller's absence.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Mason Tipton
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Tipton underwent tibia surgery in the offseason, and as a result, he opened training camp on the active/PUP list, ultimately failing to play during the preseason. The wide receiver will now be forced to miss at least four contests to open the regular season, and the earliest he'd be able to return to action is Week 5 versus the Vikings on Oct. 11.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Moliki Matavao
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Matavao sustained a knee injury during Saturday's 34-0 preseason loss to the Rams. The tight end's placement on IR means he will miss the entirety of the 2026 regular season unless he is waived with an injury settlement. Matavao logged three catches for 34 yards in Saturday's game and seemed to have a good chance to make the 53-man roster.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Nick Saldiveri
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Saldiveri is apparently still working his way back onto the field from the knee injury he suffered back in December of 2024. As it stands, he'll now have to miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 campaign.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Rejzohn Wright
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The cornerback suffered a hip injury earlier in training camp that will now require season-ending surgery. White logged 35 special-teams snaps for New Orleans in 2025, but he did not record a tackle.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Ty Chandler
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Chandler suffered a season-ending knee injury during Saturday's preseason game against the Rams. The running back has been placed on injured reserve and will miss the entirety of the 2026 season. The Saints added Zamir White in a trade with the 49ers to make up for the loss of Chandler.
